summary: Implemented prepareUpdate and the Update container in the RDFLib SPARQL plugin. Changes: Update(prologue, algebra) class in rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py; translateUpdate in algebra.py always returns an Update, building the prologue from q.prologue[0] on the empty-request path before the early exit; evalUpdate in update.py iterates update.algebra; prepareUpdate added to processor.py and exported from sparql/__init__.py; new test/test_sparql_prepare.py with 13 tests. Nothing was run, per instructions, so tests are unverified. Not committed. One test (init bindings through Graph.update on an INSERT WHERE {}) relies on an assumption I have not confirmed by execution.
